intro.title: Surgeon, teacher and academic leader.
intro.body: Dr. Bhagavan B.C. is the Vice Chancellor of Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, Karnataka. Trained in general surgery and minimal access surgery, he spent two decades on the surgical faculty of Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences, Bengaluru, where he went on to serve as Vice Principal and Principal.

visionPreview.title: Seven priorities for health sciences education.
visionPreview.body: The official profile sets out priorities for the university's future. They are presented here as stated priorities, distinct from initiatives that have been implemented.

closing.statement: Knowledge in medicine grows when it is taught, shared and carried into the service of others.
closing.body: Health sciences education shapes the doctors, nurses and practitioners who will care for the next generation. Its future depends on rigour in learning, openness to new knowledge and a lasting commitment to the communities it serves.
